defects.title: from-order endpoint rejects only Cancelled/Rejected orders; Draft/PendingConfirmation orders allowed
defects.invariant: Order state gating for bill creation must match business intent — if target is "gönderilmiş sipariş" (submitted order), Draft and PendingConfirmation should also be rejected, not only Cancelled/Rejected
defects.mechanism: BillingSplitStore.cs:427-428 only checks for OrderState.Cancelled or OrderState.Rejected. OrderState.Draft, OrderState.Submitted, OrderState.PendingConfirmation are all accepted and create bills. Test at BillingSplitHttpTests.cs:219 only tests Cancelled order rejection. Client billingApi.ts:76,86 and workspace.tsx:346-376 show orderId/billId are dynamic from order context — no fixed bill ID exists to anchor business rule.
defects.acceptance: Either: (a) update BillingSplitStore.CreateBillFromOrderAsync to also reject Draft/Submitted/PendingConfirmation with clear business rule documented in task markdown, or (b) PO confirms current behavior is intentional and task markdown is updated to reflect actual accepted states

limitations: Read-only review; business intent clarification requires PO decision. Test coverage only validates Cancelled rejection; no test exists for Draft/Submitted/PendingConfirmation paths.
review_tier: Child static-source draft; parent ID/ref validation passed; independent semantics pending
